This quest gives a [[character]] access to the [[Eye of the North]] expansion. 

== Quest information ==

=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = Nightfall
| nationality = all
| minimum = 10
| transfer = Eye of the North
| complete = Neither [[What Lies Beneath]] nor [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]]
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Investigate the [[fissure]] on {{sic}} the [[Plains of Jarin]] near [[Kamadan]].
* Enter the fissure in {{sic}} the Plains of Jarin.
* Investigate the [[Caverns Below Kamadan|Depths beneath Istan]].

=== Reward ===
* 2,500 [[Experience]]

=== Environmental changes ===
Once this quest, [[I Feel the Earth Move Under Cantha's Feet]] or [[What Lies Beneath]] has been completed, the fissure, [[chasm]] and [[crevasse]] become permanent [[interactive object]]s of their respective [[explorable area]]s.

== Walkthrough ==
Go out into the Plains of Jarin and head south.  Once you reach the fissure, click on it to be taken to the [[Caverns Below Kamadan]].  Inside you will face a circle of [[Corsair]]s. They are all level 7, and so shouldn't pose much of a threat. If you follow the path, you will eventually run into a level 11 [[Corsair Lookout]]. He will be accompanied by a level 8, a level 7, and a level 3 Corsair. When you continue along the path, you will come to a large room, where 5 Corsairs of various levels (none over level 10) will run toward you. Turn north and run to the end of the hallway. Then turn east, where you will soon see two dwarves. Pass them and continue, and you will soon hit a [[cinematic]]. [[The Beginning of the End]] is the follow-up [[primary quest]] that is automatically added to your [[quest log]].

== Notes ==
* This quest concludes automatically at the end of the cinematic; the follow-up quest, [[The Beginning of the End]], is automatically accepted.
* If you are below level 20 you will be buffed by [[Journey to the North]] within the [[Eye of the North]] expansion.
* If you have any of the other Eye of the North access quests in your [[Quest Log]], finishing one will remove them from your Quest Log.
